content:
Sam L: Morning team — quick async standup from me.
Sam L: Yesterday: landed the kernel prefetch priority tweak (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/432). Ran a small microbench on staging (2xA100) — p99 improved ~6%, median unchanged.
Sam L: Blocker: KV eviction still shows a ~200ms tail for lots of short chats (repro steps below). I can trigger locally but need help reproducing at scale.
Sam L: Today: plan to iterate on eviction window + add a lightweight metric to trace which key families evict first. Will kick off a warmup + smoke run across 4 hosts.

Jia K: Nice! skimmed the PR, left one comment about the priority ordering.
Jia K: For the KV repro — try this loop (gives the pattern we see):
```
for i in 1..1000 do
  request(prefix: "small-chitchat-" + rand())
end
```
Jia K: If you run with `KV_EVICT_DEBUG=1` you should see which slab gets nuked.

Nate R: I can run the 4-host smoke after lunch. Point me to the script and the exact tag to use.
Nate R: Also saw one NPE in the new priority comparator in the canary logs — pushed a tiny fix to the branch.

Sam L: @Nate R thanks — use tag `staging/kernel-prefetch-2026-03-17` and script `infra/bench/warmup_smoke.sh` (added to the PR).
Sam L: @Jia K good call on KV_EVICT_DEBUG, I'll add a patch to log key-family counts.

Leo P: Quick note on batching: I did a sweep over batching-configs yesterday. Found that increasing max_batch_size for small prompts helped throughput by ~12% but increased tail in mixed workloads.
Leo P: Suggestion: introduce two routes — small-prompt fast-path and default batch. That might avoid stomping KV warmups for short prompts.

Jia K: Agree with the route split idea. We should also gate the fast-path behind a runtime flag for quick rollback.

Sam L: Good plan. I'll prototype route tagging today and add a config flag.

perf-bot: benchmark job #2145 finished: https://perf.redwood.ai/jobs/2145 — p95 latency down 4.8% for the kernel-prefetch change on single-host bench.
perf-bot: artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/2145/results.json

Nate R: If perf-bot results look good, I'll spin the 4-host across `canary` tomorrow morning and watch KV eviction graphs.

Leo P: Small ask — can someone drop a short note in the rollout doc with the rollback steps? I can add the dashboard links.

Sam L: Will add rollback steps to PR description and paste links.

Jia K: Ping me after the 4-host run, I can help triage any eviction heatmaps.

Sam L: Thanks — wrapping up my checklist: 1) add KV-family counts + debug flag, 2) route-tag prototype, 3) push updated bench script. Expect updates in a couple hours. :thumbsup:

Nate R: 👍
Jia K: :thumbsup:
Leo P: :rocket:
